scope: All 41 source branches inspected in the actual live context builder and native apply dispatcher. This is a capability audit, not domain validation or a claim that all proposals can be repaired. Underlying source resolvers, approval helpers and triggers still require their own audits.
limitations: Existing field projection is shallow for nested JSON; issue metadata and prior research need an explicit model-state projection audit before broader adoption.

All currently active staging Review rows in the read-only snapshot came from public publisher/adapters. A future private staging adapter must be excluded by source authorization, not merely by queue name.
Registered policy and a generic candidate do not imply a working positive correction handler.
Existing .97/.99 decision thresholds remain; small validation samples do not certify those precision levels.
